title: FHA Flip Rule Waiver Expired – You need to wait 90 days to write a contract

faqs.q: Are homes owned by the seller for less than 90 days eligible for FHA financing?
faqs.a: No, homes that have been owned by the seller for less than 90 days are not eligible for FHA financing as of January 1, 2015.

faqs.q: When can FHA buyers write a contract on a home owned by the seller?
faqs.a: FHA buyers can write a contract only after the seller has owned the home for at least 90 days. The 90-day waiting period applies to writing the contract, not to closing the loan.

alt: The FHA flip rule waiver has expired, requiring a 90-day waiting period before reselling.
